label.explanation: orders was restored from a snapshot but its id sequence was left behind the restored rows (line 150). New inserts are handed ids that already exist and violate the primary key (lines 168, 173, 180, 196). order-service's create failures (lines 187, 205, 235, 241) and api-gateway errors (lines 160, 179, 211, 218, 231, 243, 253) follow. Reset the sequence past max(id). Red herrings: line 71 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path).
